purpose: Pin the installed RanaLD and auxiliary-PC context interfaces before researcher-run construction
source_notes: RanaLD replaces A by L@D from its no-pivot LDU factorization.
IRKAuxiliaryOperatorPC gets the original stepper from the application context and differentiates a form using the auxiliary tableau.
AuxiliaryOperatorPC uses the aux_ options prefix and stores the assembled auxiliary operator as context.P and its internal PC as context.pc.
Those inspected context attributes are implementation details pinned by these hashes; no numerical import or execution was used for this inspection.
